meta.name: gpt-taste
meta.description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造高级UI动效与排版布局
copy.tagline_en: Create advanced UI animations and typographic layouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue top-tier visual experience and GSAP motion design.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 AIDA 结构生成 React 页面：先模拟 Python 随机挑选 Hero 布局、字体与 GSAP 动画，输出 <design_plan> 校验网格密度和间距，再写带滚动动效的代码。
howto.when: 当你要它设计或实现网页 UI（尤其是带 GSAP 动效的落地页）时接管；它会在写任何代码前先输出 <design_plan> 校验块。

say.text: 帮我做一个 AIDA 结构的落地页，Hero 用超大宽度容器
say.note: 它会先给 design_plan，再出 UI 代码

say.text: 这个 Bento 网格用 grid-flow-dense，别留空单元格
say.note: 它会数格子验证列行严丝合缝

say.text: 加上 GSAP ScrollTrigger 的 pin。和文字滚动揭示
say.note: 左侧标题固定，右侧内容向上滚

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude builds React pages in AIDA order: it simulates Python randomization to pick the hero layout, font and GSAP effects, prints a <design_plan> verification, then writes scroll-animated code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to design or build web UI, especially landing pages with GSAP motion; it outputs a <design_plan> block before writing any code.

say_en.text: Build an AIDA-structured landing page with an ultra-wide hero container.
say_en.note: It prints a design_plan first, then the UI code.

say_en.text: Use grid-flow-dense on this bento grid so no cell is left empty.
say_en.note: It verifies col/row spans interlock mathematically.

say_en.text: Add GSAP ScrollTrigger pinning and scrubbed text reveals.
say_en.note: Pins a title while content scrolls past.
